name: Double layer
oneLine: Two sheets of fatty acids, tails facing in. The skin of every cell.
howItWorks: Heads face the water on both sides. Tails hide in the middle. The oily middle stops most large or charged molecules from passing through.
deeper: Every known cell is wrapped in a lipid double layer. Fatty-acid layers flip and swap molecules much faster than modern cell membranes.
sizeComparison: a 25,000th the width of a hair
simplification: The layer is drawn much thicker than scale so you can see it.
